statcraft-profile-v1.mpx is a synthetic workbook produced by StatCraft preview 17.
It contains original demonstration measurements, two worksheets and a saved
StatCraft descriptive-statistics result. It tests backwards compatibility with
the original numeric-only owned profile. It contains no user or vendor dataset.

statcraft-profile-v2.mpx is the synthetic mixed numeric/text demonstration
workbook produced by StatCraft preview 18. It tests upgrading that exact profile
to include dates without losing missing/empty text or grouped graph recipes.

statcraft-profile-v3.mpx is the synthetic dated workbook produced by preview 19.
It tests unchanged v3 saves and upgrades to numeric constants and matrices.
